definitions.gloss: management fee; maintenance charge; administration fee
definitions.explanation: A fee charged for the management, maintenance, or administration of a property, facility, or service.

examples.japanese: {管理料|かんりりょう}は{月額|げつがく}{一万円|いちまんえん}だ。
examples.english: The management fee is 10,000 yen per month.

examples.japanese: マンションの{管理料|かんりりょう}が{値上|ねあ}げされた。
examples.english: The apartment management fee was raised.

examples.japanese: {駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}の{管理料|かんりりょう}には{清掃費|せいそうひ}や{設備|せつび}の{維持費|いじひ}が{含|ふく}まれている。
examples.english: The parking lot management fee includes cleaning costs and equipment maintenance expenses.

notes:
A compound of {管理|かんり} (management, administration) and {料|りょう} (fee, charge). Commonly encountered in housing, real estate, and facility usage. In apartment living, {管理料|かんりりょう} or {管理費|かんりひ} covers shared costs like elevator maintenance, cleaning of common areas, and building security.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {管理料|かんりりょう}を{払|はら}う: to pay a management fee
- {管理料|かんりりょう}の{値上|ねあ}げ: management fee increase
- {月額|げつがく}{管理料|かんりりょう}: monthly management fee
- {管理料|かんりりょう}{込|こ}み: management fee included

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {管理費|かんりひ}: management expenses — nearly synonymous; {費|ひ} emphasizes cost/expense while {料|りょう} emphasizes a set fee
- {手数料|てすうりょう}: handling fee, commission — a fee for processing or service
- {維持費|いじひ}: maintenance costs — focuses specifically on keeping something in working condition
